# 2 Baruch Chapter 85 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "You should know that our ancestors long ago brought foreigners from Sodom to live with them and adopted their ways."

**2** "When those people perished, they were not remembered after death — there is no memory of them today."

**3** "Also know this: all our ancestors sinned, and they have gone into Sheol. They received the judgment their deeds deserved."

**4** "But we ourselves — if we obey the law of the Mighty One — will be welcomed into the world that does not pass away."

**5** "We will see what has been promised and receive what has been foretold."

**6** "For the Mighty One prepared from the very beginning all things for those who live by the commandments; he has kept everything in store for them."

**7** "You know that we have not lived righteously; you know we have not kept the law."

**8** "Look — we are in captivity right now, in a foreign land, suffering."

**9** "But the days of exile will end, the time of suffering will not go on forever, and the Mighty One will be our comfort."

**10** "If you keep the law, you will lack nothing, and the Mighty One will not abandon you."

**11** "Keep the law in mind, and the Mighty One's judgment will be righteous toward you, and his mercy will be close."

**12** "Do not transgress. Do not abandon the covenant of the Most High. Do not depart from the law of the Holy One."

**13** "I know that after our time our children will not abandon the law, and the Mighty One will be with them."

**14** "I know the Mighty One is faithful — he will not utterly abandon his people."

**15** "So now hear the final word I have to say; take it into your hearts and write it on the tablets of your mind."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
